observations.fact: An independent filing mirror reports that Infleqtion disclosed an August 2026 customer relationship with Eaton using private-cloud access to Sqale, Superstaq and quantum software for energy problems; a July 2026 signed contract to deploy a fault-tolerant neutral-atom quantum computer at the Illinois Quantum & Microelectronics Park in 2027 targeting 50 logical qubits with a roadmap to 100; a $2.0M DARPA HARQ contract; a $1.0M Navy Phase II QuIRC contract; and a $5.3M ARPA-E cost-sharing agreement.
observations.whyItMatters: This materially broadens source-addressed evidence for commercialization, catalyst, cross-division leverage and government/customer execution beyond the issuer/SEC origin set already represented in the packet.

risks.risk: The independent source is a filing mirror and its underlying facts ultimately derive from company disclosures; Alpha should retain the existing distinction between contract/customer milestones and realized recurring economics.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration, normalized gross margin and cash-burn durability remain Alpha-owned underwriting questions.
